Rules / Formatting

SK0214 The trailing comma is not arranged

skala arrange would add or remove a trailing comma in a supported list.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSyntax
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseyes
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

A trailing comma is a token rather than whitespace, so it belongs to cleanup. The rule distinguishes single-line and multiline lists and follows their separate configuration values.

Example

Instead of:

var values = new[] {
    1,
    2
};

Write:

var values = new[] {
    1,
    2,
};

When it does not fire

Only list forms for which the active language version permits a trailing comma are changed.

Configuration

  • resharper_csharp_trailing_comma_in_multiline_lists
  • resharper_csharp_trailing_comma_in_singleline_lists
